name: bun-api
title: Bun API
blurb: Bun JSON service: one Request->Response handler, Bun.serve, bun:test suites, tsc typecheck and a real socket smoke test
default_description: A JSON service in Bun with no framework.

verify.name: http
verify.cmd: PORT=5413 bun run src/server.ts >.bun.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ready=1; for _ in $(seq 1 60); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5413/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; if [ $ready -ne 0 ]; then cat .bun.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; health=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5413/health); stats=$(curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:5413/stats?text=hello%20world%0A'); posted=$(curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"text":"a b\nc\n"}' http://127.0.0.1:5413/stats); bad=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5413/stats); missing=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5413/nope); kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null || true; cat .bun.log; test "$health" = 200 && printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"lines":1' && printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"bytes":12' && printf '%s' "$posted" | grep -q '"words":3' && test "$bad" = 422 && test "$missing" = 404
